scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @tablet-control/controller-api" "npm run dev --workspace @tablet-control/controller-web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @tablet-control/shared-types && npm run build --workspace @tablet-control/integration-contracts
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @tablet-control/controller-api && npm run build --workspace @tablet-control/controller-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
